svg.title: KurtShape concept mockup: Main workspace · restrained polish
svg.desc: Concept mockup, not a screenshot. Keeps the light shell, icon-only rows, SolidWorks navigation and the native renderer; changes are styling, grouping and status placement.

g.text: End of history · drag to roll back
Bold = target for new features · right-click to change
CONCEPT MOCKUP · not a screenshot of implemented behavior
Keeps the light shell, icon-only rows, SolidWorks navigation and the native renderer; changes are styling, grouping and status placement.
Toolbar families separated by thin dividers and a consistent 34 px pitch; the same 20 px grayscale SVG language everywhere (no native fallback glyphs
History icons use the grayscale set with state carried by text/row (italic + muted when rolled back, red cross when failed), not by native colored glyphs.
Rollback line gets a 14 px handle and a label that says what it does; dragging stays the only way to roll back.
Parts: one list, no duplicate chooser; the active target is bold with an 'Active' tag and a one-line explanation.
Status bar zones: left = model truth (solid count, build state, unsaved), centre = view context, right = Messages. No transient completion text here.
NaviCube drawn lighter and without rotation arrows (native NaviCube settings: size, colors, arrows off).
Document tabs show a modified dot, not the native ' : 1*' suffix; the close glyph is neutral gray.
Viewport: unchanged renderer; MSAA 4x and the 12-degree angular deflection preset (Mod/Part MeshAngularDeflection) smooth silhouettes and
fillets; edges stay black 1 px; the preview ghost tessellates with the same rule as the model.
